_meta.rule: Declared before the first evaluation run. Do not change after results are reported; add a revised value next to the original and explain it in the Testing wiki page.

verdict_accuracy.definition: Cases whose actual verdict (accept/reject) equals the expected verdict, over all cases.

problem_match.definition: Cases whose set of reported problems (kind, ingredient, field) equals the expected set, over all cases. This is also the overall ground-truth pass rate.

restriction_rejection.definition: Restriction-conflict cases (groups allergy, dietary_approach, depends_on_product, multiple_restrictions) that are rejected for exactly the expected ingredient, over those cases.

false_rejection_free.definition: Accept cases (group accept) that are accepted with no problem, over those cases.

schema_validity.definition: Schema cases (group schema) that are rejected with exactly the expected problem, over those cases.
